payout_value_note: Flat $50 to the referrer and $50 to the new member. Maximum 10 referral bonuses per calendar year ($500).
payout_quote: Referral Bonuses: The same $50 bonus will be paid to the referrer (existing Member) and referee (new Member). ... Maximum 10 referral bonuses per calendar year.
steps: Existing member refers a friend/family member; the new member must provide the referrer's name when the new checking account is opened (or a completed Referrer Form).
New member opens an eligible personal checking account (Everyday, Access, or Pacific Checking; $25 minimum opening deposit).
New member: enrolls in eStatements; signs up and qualifies for a debit card; sets up and receives direct deposit within 60 days of account opening (Social Security counts).
Account must remain open with eStatement preference for 90 days, or the bonus may be reversed.
Bonuses paid by deposit to respective checking accounts within 90 days after all eligibility requirements are met.
catches: Maximum 10 referral bonuses per calendar year.
New member must enroll in eStatements, qualify for a debit card, and set up direct deposit within 60 days.
Checking account must stay open with eStatements for 90 days or the bonus may be reversed.

Offer only available at branch locations; not combinable with other offers.
Associates of Orange County's FCU are not eligible.
Limited-time promotion subject to change/termination without notice.
biggest_catch: The bonus may be reversed if the friend's account doesn't stay open with eStatements for 90 days, and payout takes up to 90 days after qualification.
eligibility: Orange County's FCU membership; referrer must be an existing member with a checking account; 'new member' means never been an owner/signer on an OCFCU account.
timing: Referral ~5 min active; bonuses paid within 90 days after all requirements are met.
